scope: opt-in Linux configured-member restart recovery; not reserve/initialize/invite orchestration

reconcile_to_ready.definition: one CLI --once pass, starting stopped A and checking already-running B; elapsed includes CLI startup, registry/profile checks, durable status and both UID-authenticated readiness checks; filesystem/page cache warm; no provider

warm_reconcile.definition: 10 sequential CLI --once passes, both members already ready; no parallel worker

ready_http.definition: 20 sequential HTTP GET /health/ready over each private Unix socket from guest root; Python http.client incl connect+headers+close; no TLS/public gateway/provider

performance.limits: shared physical host; uncontrolled host load; 2-member preview only; not 1/5/20 capacity or paired dev.30 baseline

real_reboot.timing_definition: one already-planned VM reboot: systemctl reboot request through new SSH availability, fresh worker status and both old owner cookies accepted; includes guest boot and polling, not pure runtime startup
